records.jp: し、詩帆って……ええええ！？！？
records.en_original: Sh-Shiho...? That's... Whaaaat?!
records.en_auxiliary: Sh-Shiho...? That's... Whaaaat?!
records.en: Sh-Shiho... Whaaaaat?!

records.jp: 見て、スマホにも……
records.en_original: And look...
records.en_auxiliary: And look...
records.en: Look, it's on my phone too...

records.jp: 春日詩帆さんがグループに参加しました
records.en_original: Shiho Kasuga joined the group.
records.en_auxiliary: Shiho Kasuga joined the group.
records.en: Kasuga Shiho-san joined the group.

records.jp: な、何これ勝手に……！？<CR>もう、意味分かんないんだけど！
records.en_original: Wh-why did that happen all of a sudden?! What's going on?!
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-why did that happen all of a sudden?! What's going on?!
records.en: Wh-what is this? It happened on its own...?!<CR>I don't understand any of this!

records.jp: 詩帆ちゃん、だよね？<CR>あの、わたし……靭こころだよ！　分かる、かな？
records.en_original: Shiho... It's you, isn't it? I-it's me, Kokoro. Kokoro Utsubo! Do you remember me?
records.en_auxiliary: Shiho... It's you, isn't it? I-it's me, Kokoro. Kokoro Utsubo! Do you remember me?
records.en: Shiho-chan, right?<CR>Um, I'm... Utsubo Kokoro! Do you recognize me?

records.jp: 靭、さん……
records.en_original: Kokoro Utsubo...?
records.en_auxiliary: Kokoro Utsubo...?
records.en: Utsubo...san...

records.en_original: Huh...?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh...?
records.en: Huh—

records.jp: ごめんなさい、わたし……何も覚えてなくて。<CR>自分が春日詩帆であるということしか……
records.en_original: I'm sorry, I... I don't remember anything. I know that I'm Shiho Kasuga, but that's it...
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sorry, I... I don't remember anything. I know that I'm Shiho Kasuga, but that's it...
records.en: I'm sorry. I... don't remember anything.<CR>Nothing except that I'm Kasuga Shiho...

records.jp: そ、そんな……
records.en_original: No...
records.en_auxiliary: No...
records.en: N-no...

records.jp: 記憶が、ない……
records.en_original: Her memories are gone...
records.en_auxiliary: Her memories are gone...
records.en: She has no memories...

records.jp: 私たちと同じ、ってこと？
records.en_original: Just like us.
records.en_auxiliary: Just like us.
records.en: You mean she's like us?

records.jp: あ、あの！　あなたたちは一体……？<CR>それにここは……？
records.en_original: Wh-who are you? And where am I?
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-who are you? And where am I?
records.en: U-um! Who exactly are all of you...?<CR>And where is this...?

records.jp: 待って待って。あたしたちも混乱してるの。<CR>一旦落ち着いて話せる場所に移動しない？
records.en_original: Hold on a second. I think we're all kind of confused. Why don't we calm down and go somewhere we can talk.
records.en_auxiliary: Hold on a second. I think we're all kind of confused. Why don't we calm down and go somewhere we can talk.
records.en: Wait, wait. We're confused too.<CR>Why don't we move somewhere we can calm down and talk?

records.jp: そう、だね。場所を変えよう
records.en_original: Good idea. Let's go somewhere else.
records.en_auxiliary: Good idea. Let's go somewhere else.
records.en: Good idea. Let's go somewhere else.

records.jp: ココロトープ……リフナビ……
records.en_original: The Heartscape... ReSource...
records.en_auxiliary: The Heartscape... ReSource...
records.en: The Heartscape... ReSource...

records.jp: いろいろあって、モンスター？　と戦って、<CR>記憶を取り戻した……んですよね？
records.en_original: And...demons? Which you fought, and then got your memories back... Do I have that right?
records.en_auxiliary: And...demons? Which you fought, and then got your memories back... Do I have that right?
records.en: A lot happened, and you fought... monsters, was it?<CR>Then you recovered your memories... right?

records.jp: そう。ついこの間ね
records.en_original: That's right. It was just the other day.
records.en_auxiliary: That's right. It was just the other day.
records.en: That's right. It was just the other day.

records.jp: 確かなことは言えませんが……<CR>なんだか、普通ではない気がします
records.en_original: I can't say for sure, but... Something about that doesn't seem right.
records.en_auxiliary: I can't say for sure, but... Something about that doesn't seem right.
records.en: I can't say for certain, but...<CR>Something about that doesn't seem normal.

records.jp: そうだと思う。私たちも、<CR>靭さんと星崎さん以外記憶がないけど――
records.en_original: No, you're right. Hoshizaki and Utsubo are the only ones who have their memories.
records.en_auxiliary: No, you're right. Hoshizaki and Utsubo are the only ones who have their memories.
records.en: I think so. We don't have our memories either,<CR>except for Utsubo-san and Hoshizaki-san—

records.jp: この世界が私たちの住んでた世界ではないってことは、<CR>なんとなく分かってきたところ
records.en_original: But what we do know is that this place isn't the world we used to live in.
records.en_auxiliary: But what we do know is that this place isn't the world we used to live in.
records.en: We're only just starting to realize<CR>that this isn't the world we used to live in.

records.jp: あの、わたし思ったんですけど――
records.en_original: Um... So, does that mean...
records.en_auxiliary: Um... So, does that mean...
records.en: Um, I was just thinking—

records.jp: わたしたちは、閉じ込められてるんですか？
records.en_original: ...We're trapped here?
records.en_auxiliary: ...We're trapped here?
records.en: Are we... trapped here?

records.jp: あー……言われてみれば、そう……なのかな？
records.en_original: Huh... I guess now that you mention it, we kind of are.
records.en_auxiliary: Huh... I guess now that you mention it, we kind of are.
records.en: Huh... I guess now that you mention it, we kind of are.

records.jp: そういうふうに考えたことなかったな～。<CR>ここで生活する分には何一つ困らないし
records.en_original: I never really thought of it that way. I mean, we've always had everything we needed to live here.
records.en_auxiliary: I never really thought of it that way. I mean, we've always had everything we needed to live here.
records.en: I never thought of it that way.<CR>I mean, we have everything we need to live here.

records.jp: わたし、ちょっと学校を見て回りたいです
records.en_original: Is it possible for me to take a look around the school?
records.en_auxiliary: Is it possible for me to take a look around the school?
records.en: I'd like to look around the school a little.

records.jp: うん。ここから出ていく手段が見つかってない以上、<CR>いろいろ知っておいた方がいいだろうしね
records.en_original: Sure. You might as well familiarize yourself with everything if we're gonna be stuck here.
records.en_auxiliary: Sure. You might as well familiarize yourself with everything if we're gonna be stuck here.
records.en: Sure. Since we haven't found a way out,<CR>you should probably learn as much as you can.

records.jp: こころ、案内してあげたら？
records.en_original: Kokoro, do you wanna show her around?
records.en_auxiliary: Kokoro, do you wanna show her around?
records.en: Kokoro, do you wanna show her around?

records.jp: ……ごめん愛央ちゃん。お願いしてもいいかな？
records.en_original: ...Sorry, Ao. Do you think you could?
records.en_auxiliary: ...Sorry, Ao. Do you think you could?
records.en: ...Sorry, Ao-chan. Could you do it?

records.jp: ……そか。分かった。じゃあ、わたしが案内するね
records.en_original: ...Gotcha. Okay. I'll show her around, then.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Gotcha. Okay. I'll show her around, then.
records.en: ...Gotcha. Okay. I'll show her around, then.

records.jp: うん、お願い
records.en_original: Thank you.
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you.
records.en: Yeah. Please do.

records.jp: 靭さん……
records.en_original: Kokoro...
records.en_auxiliary: Kokoro...
records.en: Utsubo-san...

records.jp: ……ごめんね。悪気はないんだ
records.en_original: ...Sorry. She doesn't mean anything by it.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Sorry. She doesn't mean anything by it.
records.en: ...Sorry. She doesn't mean anything by it.

records.jp: ああ、わたしは全然。ただ、靭さんが……
records.en_original: No, I'm fine... But, Kokoro...
records.en_auxiliary: No, I'm fine... But, Kokoro...
records.en: Oh, I'm fine. It's Utsubo-san I'm worried about...

records.jp: ……今はそっとしておいてあげた方がいいかもね。<CR>きっと、整理がついてないだろうから
records.en_original: ...It's probably best to leave her be for now. She just needs some time to adjust.
records.en_auxiliary: ...It's probably best to leave her be for now. She just needs some time to adjust.
records.en: ...It might be best to leave her alone for now.<CR>I'm sure she hasn't sorted out her feelings yet.

records.jp: そう、ですね
records.en_original: Yes, I suppose so...
records.en_auxiliary: Yes, I suppose so...
records.en: Yes... I suppose so.

records.jp: それじゃ、行こっか
records.en_original: Well then, let's get going.
records.en_auxiliary: Well then, let's get going.
records.en: Well then, let's get going.

records.jp: はい、よろしくお願いします
records.en_original: Okay. Lead the way.
records.en_auxiliary: Okay. Lead the way.
records.en: Yes. Thank you for showing me around.

records.jp: タレントに、学校開発の効果を高める能力が<CR>解放されました
records.en_original: A new ability in your Talents that boosts the effects of facilities has been unlocked.
records.en_auxiliary: A new ability in your Talents that boosts the effects of facilities has been unlocked.
records.en: A Talent ability that boosts school development effects<CR>has been unlocked.
